data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate closed 2015 with a gross release on prior year claims provisions of GBP 59.584m (a c.18.2% reduction versus opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 327.771m). The technical provisions table shows this as a gross reduction in prior year provisions partially offset by an increase in reinsurers' share, indicating that benign claims experience and reinsurance recoveries were the primary drivers of the release.
raw_causal_phrases: Loss experience was more favourable than expected and there were no significant catastrophe events affecting the portfolio.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding and the prior year movement were extracted from the Technical Provisions reconciliation table (Incurred claims outstanding) on page 32. The prior year movement used is the GROSS 'Change in prior year provisions' row. The claims development (triangle) was transcribed from the Gross claims development table on page 31 (numbers in the triangle are in GBP '000). No specific named catastrophe events affecting reserves are stated in the technical notes; causation (favourable development and reinsurance recoveries) is inferred from narrative and the movement row. Some development-triangle cells for the most recent years are blank by construction; triangle transcription was taken from the printed table image and some later-period cells are null where development not yet reported.
